definitions.explanation: Changing from one mode of transportation to another, or from one flight/train to another, during a journey.

examples.japanese: シンガポール⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{乗|の}り{継|つ}ぎ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
{乗|の}り{継|つ}ぎ⟦{時間|じかん}→時間：00468_jikan⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧2⟦{時間|じかん}→時間：00468_jikan⟧です。
examples.english: The layover time is two hours.

examples.japanese: {乗|の}り{継|つ}ぎ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{失敗|しっぱい}→失敗：01636_shippai⟧⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧、⟦{次|つぎ}→次：00819_tsugi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{便|びん}→便：28160_bin⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{待|ま}つ→待つ：00469_matsu⟧ことになった。
examples.english: I missed my connection and had to wait for the next flight.

notes:
Used for both air travel (connecting flights) and ground transportation (transferring trains or buses).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {乗|の}り{継|つ}ぎ{便|びん} (connecting flight)
- {乗|の}り{継|つ}ぎ⟦{時間|じかん}→時間：00468_jikan⟧ (layover/transfer time)
- {乗|の}り{継|つ}ぎ⟦{客|きゃく}→客：00865_kyaku⟧ (transit passenger)
- {乗|の}り{継|つ}ぎ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to make a transfer)

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{乗|の}り{換|か}え→乗り換え：16130_norikae⟧: changing trains (often used for trains within a city)
- ⟦{直行便|ちょっこうびん}→直行便：10098_chokkoubin⟧: direct flight
- ⟦{経由|けいゆ}→経由：02791_keiyu⟧: via, by way of
